reconciliation_decisions.tbi: Retain owner-accepted conservative local observation layer and historical version caveat. Correct perfusion goal and conditional product-specific nicardipine schedule. Add surgical thresholds and selected short seizure prophylaxis. Existing HTS contract source anchor unchanged.
reconciliation_decisions.niv: Adopt ATS2026 recommendation comparators and preserve syndrome-specific indications; no universal HFNO-over-NIV assertion; remove unsupported universal backup rate.
reconciliation_decisions.calcium: Require verified elemental mmol and hydrate: generic10% calcium chloride equivalence cannot transfer to hexahydrate.
reconciliation_decisions.magnesium_timing: RCUK March2026 and ERC ALS:8mmol over10min in perfusing torsades; ERC special-circumstances table lists1-2min. Choose specific tachyarrhythmia algorithm for this setting; do not assert the discrepancy is absent or invent a formal erratum. Severe symptomatic deficiency loading15min remains separate from ordinary slow replacement.
reconciliation_decisions.preparation: Intermittent examples are conditional verified-label arithmetic, not an assumed local product. No generic continuous infusion recipe or blanket24h hang-time approved.
